seo.title: Schools and community | Dojo da Luz Lisbon
seo.description: Discover the learning spaces, people and moments of Dojo da Luz schools in Lisbon.

title: Learning together, growing through practice.
lead: Learning spaces where Aikido brings together people of different ages and paths.

introduction.title: Every school, a place to begin.
introduction.subtitle: Attention · relationship · continuity
paragraphs: Dojo da Luz schools share an approach to learning based on regular practice, attention to one’s partner and respect for every process.
The tatami brings children, young people and adults together in a space where movement becomes listening, trust and discovery.
